gaps.title: Adults are scaled-up child dolls
gaps.detail: Halvard and the other adults need real Toriyama adult bodies and faces: head about one quarter of height, thick moving eyebrows, eyes with whites, shaggy hair and beard silhouette, barrel chest about twice the waist, thick arms, greatsword touching the ground. Reuse that adult head and face kit for grown Bram and the villagers.

gaps.title: Hero reads too small at the gameplay camera
gaps.detail: At distance 10.5 and FOV 50 the real six-year-old Bram is much smaller than the placeholder the approved frames were composed around. Either the hero scale or the camera framing must change so he reads.

gaps.title: The hero on screen is an adult, sunk into the ground, and too close to the lens
gaps.detail: Orchestrator eyes, 2026-09-18 10:00, shots/_plugcheck2/01-boot.png (cold boot of /index.html): the figure the player controls is a long-haired ADULT in a blue tunic with a drawn sword, not the round six-year-old Bram in the green travelling cloak that CANON and docs/approved/hero-close.png describe. His legs are cut off by the ground plane (feet below the terrain), and he fills a third of the frame height. Three things to check: which char id the field actually builds (chars.js knows 'hero'), the ground-height sampling that places him, and the scale agreed with the camera piece. A child must see the boy from the story, standing on the ground.
